findings.finding: Corrective patterns may be difficult to recognize until complete, and triangles should not be declared complete prematurely; no deterministic general completion boundary is defined.
After a pattern has been identified as complete, later price action can refute that conclusion; this is confirmation/invalidation practice, not an independent proof of completion.
The degree of developing waves may be impossible to identify precisely and later events clarify it; developing status cannot be silently converted to complete.

reason: The book uses completion contextually but does not specify deterministic, pattern-general inputs and boundaries for DEVELOPING, COMPLETE, and UNRESOLVED_COMPLETION.
